description: This file contains helper functions for managing AppArmor profiles in Kubernetes pods, including determining if AppArmor is required and retrieving profile names based on annotations and security contexts.

methods.name: isRequired
methods.description: Checks whether AppArmor is required for the given pod based on security context and annotations.

methods.name: GetProfile
methods.description: Returns the AppArmor profile to use for a specific container within a pod.

methods.name: getProfileFromPodAnnotations
methods.description: Retrieves the AppArmor profile from pod annotations, handling deprecated annotation keys.
